$comment: Maia Mission Control palette — dark-only operations-console theme. Design reference for the SonoBus/audio-server appearance pass; not yet wired into code. Keep in sync with maia-mission-control.md.
name: maia-mission-control

categorical.$comment: Validated distinguishable on 'panel' and colour-blind safe. In SonoBus: per-channel-group / per-peer identity. Never chrome, never status.

rules: The petrol accent is for interface chrome, never for a data series.
Status colours are never reused as categorical colours.
Text always uses the ink tokens, never a series colour; a small coloured dot or mark next to the text carries the category.
Keep marks thin and saturation restrained; let surfaces stay quiet so the few coloured elements stand out.
Status is always paired with a text label or icon, never colour alone.
